Independent Evercraft commercial product | part of the Evercraft OS portfolio.

Exact Stripe SKU: AI Boardroom · Deep Dive with Financial Modeling
Price: USD 500 (one-time scoped service)
Ideal buyer: Operators comparing business plans whose assumptions materially affect the decision
Problem: A business choice looks attractive until the assumptions change.
Promise: See the financial assumptions before they surprise you.
Scoped deliverable: A written review and agreed scenario table with assumptions, sensitivity discussion and limitations
Required buyer inputs: Decision, scenario questions, available cost and revenue assumptions and approved source data
Agreement needed: Scenario variables, number of cases, review boundaries, deliverable and timeline
Not included: No guaranteed projections, investment returns, valuation certification or licensed financial advice
Intent match examples:
- business financial scenario modeling
- sensitivity analysis for a startup decision
- AI Boardroom financial deep dive
